items.say: A leaf! Leaves turn orange in fall!
A flower! Flowers need sun and rain!
A bird flies in the sky! It says...
A frog hops at the pond! It says...
An owl wakes up at night! It says...

song:
Leaf and flower,
apple so red,

Bird in the sky
up over my head,

Frog in the pond,
owl says goodnight,

youtube.title: Twiggy's Nature Words! (WHOOSH!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🍃 WHOOSH! A big wind shook Twiggy the tree and blew all of Twiggy's nature friends away! Can you help Twiggy find them?

Twiggy learns 6 nature words: leaf, flower, apple, bird, frog and owl! The place changes with each friend (the forest, the park, the sky, the pond and the night) and you hear the REAL sounds of the bird, the frog and the owl. Then sing along with Twiggy, and stay till the end, because something round is hiding in the forest! 🌳

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 6 nature words: leaf, flower, apple, bird, frog and owl
✔️ See where each one lives: forest, park, sky, pond and night
✔️ Hear the real sounds of a bird, a frog and an owl
✔️ Sing a nature song with Twiggy!

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Hello from Twiggy!
0:04 WHOOSH! Oh no!
0:09 Let's find the nature words!
0:26 Sing along!
0:46 Something round is peeking!
0:56 What do you see outside?

💬 What do you see outside? Tell Twiggy in the comments!
